title: AKI in a man with dementia, home; goals, pending results, plan discussion and transmission each negated in wording the negation filter misses

rationale.pending_results: The pending urine culture is listed, but the note says 'No one has been assigned to follow up on the result', so the follow-up owner the rule requires is missing.
rationale.goals_of_care: The section only records that the proxy 'declined to discuss' and that the topic was 'never addressed'; no code status, directive or goals are documented.
rationale.info_transmitted: The fax was rejected and the note says 'Never transmitted'; an attempted send is not evidence the summary reached the PCP.
rationale.dp_discussed: The patient lacks capacity and the CM note says the plan was 'to be reviewed' with the daughter but 'no one available'; nursing confirms no teach-back, so no discussion with the patient or representative is documented.
rationale.med_changes: Hydrochlorothiazide stopped with reason and lisinopril continued unchanged are both stated.
rationale.pac_list: Home without services, so the post-acute rules do not apply.
